validity.why: In the centred-step layout the w2 part of resonators 1/3 begins at x = l1 where the input/output strip ends, and the fixed-width 50 ohm feed ends at x = 0 where resonator 1 begins; when the wider element reaches past the gap the rectangles share an edge and are fused into one conductor (3 instead of 5 copper components): a shorted device, not a coupled-line filter. 0 < clearance < 0.05 mm is a corner-to-corner near-touch that the production mesh (0.144 mm edge size, ~1 element across g1) cannot resolve, so those are excluded too.
validity.nominal: the tuned nominal has clearance 0.061 mm (feed corner vs resonator 1): valid, in the marginal band; its coarse-vs-fine mesh check (f0 -1.44 %) is what covers that band
validity.invalid_samples: kept on disk under data/invalid (npz) and tagged invalid-geometry in the run DB; never used for training
